include_directories(${REACTOS_SOURCE_DIR}/ntoskrnl/include)

# The usbehci .c bodies (debug/roothub/usbehci) are replaced by Rust (usbehci-rust,
# libusbehci_rust.a). The .c files are kept on disk per the never-delete rule. guid.c stays
# compiled as a data-only TU (DEFINE_GUID). Bar: link-clean x3 (NOT boot-loaded in smoke).

# usbehci.sys is all Rust (usbehci-rust) and cargo links it:
# sdk/lib/rust/usbehci-cargo (reactos-link, generated by tools/cargo_cell_gen.py).
# The C stays on disk, uncompiled.
# The C still compiled, in an OBJECT library whose compile the cargo link replays.
# How cmake compiled the target's sources, now on the OBJECT libraries.
add_library(usbehci_shims OBJECT guid.c)
target_link_libraries(usbehci_shims PRIVATE libusbport libusbd libhal libntoskrnl)
target_compile_definitions(usbehci_shims
    # HACK: Disabled until USB Stack is reinvestigated.
    PRIVATE NO_KERNEL_LIST_ENTRY_CHECKS)
add_cargo_module(usbehci usbehci-cargo usbehci.sys
    KIND kernelmodedriver
    BODY_CRATE usbehci-rust
    DESTINATION reactos/system32/drivers
    NO_CAB
    EXTRA_DEPENDS usbehci_shims psdk)
